title: Efficient Estimation of Word Representations in Vector Space
abstract: We propose two novel model architectures for computing continuous vector representations of words from very large data sets.

title: GloVe: Global Vectors for Word Representation
abstract: GloVe combines the advantages of global matrix factorization and local context window methods.

title: Sequence to Sequence Learning with Neural Networks
abstract: We present a general end-to-end approach to sequence learning that makes minimal assumptions on the sequence structure.

title: Google's Neural Machine Translation System: Bridging the Gap between Human and Machine Translation
authors: Yonghui Wu;Mike Schuster;Zhifeng Chen;Quoc V. Le;Mohammad Norouzi;Wolfgang Macherey;Maxim Krikun;et al.
abstract: We present the GNMT system a deep LSTM network with 8 encoder and 8 decoder layers using attention connections.

title: RoBERTa: A Robustly Optimized BERT Pretraining Approach
authors: Yinhan Liu;Myle Ott;Naman Goyal;Jingfei Du;Mandar Joshi;Danqi Chen;Omer Levy;Mike Lewis;Luke Zettlemoyer;Ves Stoyanov
abstract: We present a replication study of BERT pretraining that carefully measures the impact of many key hyperparameters and training data size.

title: SQuAD: 100000+ Questions for Machine Comprehension of Text
abstract: We introduce the Stanford Question Answering Dataset SQuAD a new reading comprehension dataset consisting of questions posed by crowdworkers on a set of Wikipedia articles.

title: Distant Supervision for Relation Extraction without Labeled Data
abstract: We investigate an alternative approach to relation extraction that does not require any manually labeled training data.

title: A Neural Conversational Model
abstract: We present a simple approach to conversational modeling using a sequence to sequence framework.
